subject: Re: Add-ons pricing — retention, tracing sample rates, dashboard tiers
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Tom Liang <tom.liang@acme-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Add-on pricing options: retention, tracing, advanced dashboards

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great discussion about using longer-term observability for your fraud models. Attached is a concise pricing grid with three add-on bundles we discussed (see acme_mop_pricing_v3.xlsx):

- Retention Plus: 90 days of full trace + 1 year of aggregated metrics.
- Tracing Pro: configurable sampling up to 100% for critical routes; base 10% included.
- Dashboards Advanced: per-seat dashboards + custom prescriptive panels (SLAs & anomaly alerts).

Estimated incremental ARR for your projected 50k tokens/day workload is in the sheet; highlights: retention is billed per GB-month, tracing overage by sampled-span count, dashboards by named user.

A few commercial notes:
- We can grant a 15% trial discount for the first 6 months on add-ons for your POC.
- If you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity add-on, we can extend to 25% discount and include a 30-day proof of concept extension.

Would you like us to sketch a bundled SKU that includes lower tracing sample cost and extended retention for the pilot? If yes, I’ll loop in Ben for the technical sizing and Marissa for commercial approval.

Best,

--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

> Subject: Re: Add-on pricing options: retention, tracing, advanced dashboards
>
> Hi Sergio,
>
> Thanks for the detailed sheet — quick questions before we present to procurement:
>
> 1) For Retention Plus: can you clarify the difference between "full trace" storage and "aggregated metrics" billing? Our compliance team needs predictable spend.
>
> 2) Tracing: our SREs want 50% sampling on the checkout flow for the first 3 months. What would the incremental cost look like compared to the base 10%?
>
> 3) Dashboards: is there a limit on the number of custom panels? We’ll likely want 6-8 prescriptive views.
>
> Also, Tom asked about whether any discounts can be escalated if we convert the POC to a committed Dedicated deployment within 90 days.
>
> Can you and your team respond with a short options matrix and a recommended path for a cost-constrained POC?
>
> Cheers,
> Elena
> Director, Reliability Engineering
> Clearsight AI
>

On Fri, 03 Apr 2026 at 10:45, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
> To: Elena Morris <elena@clearsight.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
> Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
> Subject: Re: Add-on pricing options: retention, tracing, advanced dashboards
>
> Hi Elena — quick technical breakdown below (will keep it short):
>
> - Full trace storage: raw span payloads stored per trace. Billing unit is GB-month. This is where sampling rate has the biggest cost impact.
> - Aggregated metrics: derived counters/histograms stored as pre-aggregated time series; much lower cardinality and billed separately (lower $/GB).
> - Example: 50% sampling of checkout flow adds ~0.42 GB/day based on your current traffic (est.). That translates to roughly $12/day at our standard retention tier (90d) — see retention-cost-breakdown.pdf for the math.
> - Dashboards: advanced panels are carriage-limited by named dashboard slots in the Advanced bundle; 6-8 panels fits in the "Team" tier. Unlimited custom panels are available in Enterprise with an extra SKU.
>
> Commercially, if you keep sample rates high for 90 days and then drop to 10% after the model tuning period, the one-time pilot cost is predictable. If you want an estimate for a 30/60/90 day ramp profile, tell me the exact endpoints you want sampled and I’ll produce a short delta table.
>
> Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk Tom and the SRE team through sampling effects on cost.
>
> Cheers,
> Ben Carter
> Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
> ben@redwood.ai


On Mon, 05 Apr 2026 at 08:30, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
> To: Elena Morris <elena@clearsight.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
> Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
> Subject: Re: Add-on pricing options: retention, tracing, advanced dashboards
>
> Hi Elena —
>
> Thanks for surfacing the procurement questions. Commercial proposal / recommended path for a cost-constrained POC: 
>
> Option A (Lean POC) — Goal: validate model performance w/ minimal incremental spend
> - Retention: 30 days full trace retention for checkout flows only; aggregated metrics 90 days.
> - Tracing: 50% sampling for 30 days during tuning, auto-fallback to 10% afterwards.
> - Dashboards: Team tier (up to 8 custom panels).
> - Commercial: 20% add-on discount for 6-month term; 30-day trial extension; ROI review at 30 days.
>
> Option B (Expand-ready) — Goal: validate and operationalize for Dedicated conversion
> - Retention: 90 days full trace for critical routes; aggregated metrics 1 year.
> - Tracing: 50% sampling for 90 days.
> - Dashboards: Enterprise tier with unlimited panels (included for pilot).
> - Commercial: 25% discount on add-ons if a 12-month reserved commitment for Dedicated is signed within 90 days; includes one-time migration credit.
>
> We can also do a blended deal: lean pricing for the first 90 days, with a retroactive credit if you convert to Dedicated within Q2. I propose we offer a capped per-month pilot spend number to give procurement comfort.
>
> Next steps: if you confirm which option (A/B/blend), I’ll convert to a short SOW and DocuSign-ready quote.
>
> Best,
> Marissa Cole
> Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
> marissa@redwood.ai
>
